normalized_packet_field_group_rows.purpose: Make every normalized source packet identifiable before extraction.
Preserve how the content entered the workbench and prevent untraceable evidence.
Support deterministic replay, duplicate detection, and audit lineage.
Separate modern market data, stale history, regulatory geography, and unknown-date content.
Record why a parser/chunker is appropriate and where it is weak.
Guarantee extraction candidates can cite stable paragraph/page/table/row/quote anchors.
Prevent disclaimers, ads, bios, ratings, and third-party price targets from becoming system conclusions.
Capture structured values without converting context snapshots into trade signals.
Score whether the source can support future evidence claims or must be quarantined/held.
Route normalized content to extraction lanes while keeping asset links candidate-only.
Make downstream extraction impossible until normalization is complete or explicitly held.
Preserve review-only boundaries and stop normalized packets from becoming analyst outputs.

quarantine_partition_rows.reason: Not evidence-bearing for investment research claims.
May describe risk/limitations but cannot support company thesis by itself.
Can be captured as source claim only; cannot become DEAN-OS recommendation or price target.
Needs stable anchor before extraction promotion.
Price/volume values need provider, timestamp/window, and no-trade-signal flag.
